page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Running on the KVM hypervisor, this instance features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 ratio of threads per core, the instance provides dedicated CPU allocation without hyperthreading, ensuring consistent and predictable compute performance. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

The instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, which facilitates high-throughput data transfers. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this instance purely for CPU-bound and memory-aligned workloads rather than storage-heavy or hardware-accelerated tasks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge offers a high-density, high-frequency compute profile. The dedicated core allocation eliminates resource contention, making it highly suitable for enterprise-grade workloads that require stable, high-frequency processing. Appropriate workloads include high-performance computing, large-scale web serving, application servers, batch processing, and distributed analytics where predictable CPU performance is critical.
